reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Since August 2026 Lakeside Water's billing dispute ticket volume stepped up from ~600/month to ~1200+/month and has held at that level (E-02). The sole currently-supported mechanism, H-IMPORT-RULE-CHANGE, holds that a billing import/validation defect around August causes bills computed from accepted meter reads to be processed incorrectly, triggering disputes — evidenced by 59% of disputed bills using an ACTUAL (not ESTIMATED) read (E-05), which rules out missing-read estimate substitution as the dominant cause while response speed (E-01) and tariff changes (E-04/E-07) are also ruled out.
